events.title: European Shares Set For Firm Open Ahead Of Fed Verdict
events.description: European stocks are seen opening a tad higher on Wednesday ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision later in the day, with markets pricing in a 92.4 percent chance of a 25-bps rate hike in response to a recent hot inflation report.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher on Wednesday after falling sharply in the previous session on concerns over rising oil and U.S. bond yields amid escalating Middle East tensions.

events.title: Australian Market Slightly Trims Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is slightly trimming its early gains in mid-market moves on Wednesday, reversing some of the losses in the previous session, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving well above the 8,650 level, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with gains in energy and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Higher
events.description: Asian stock markets are mostly higher on Wednesday, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as traders are cautious and seemed reluctant to make more significant moves ahead of the US Fed's monetary policy decision later in the day. Some traders are looking to pick stocks at a bargain following the recent slump in the markets. Asian markets closed mostly lower on Tuesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Flat To Higher At Open
events.description: Indian shares may see a fragile, tentative recovery at the open on Wednesday following the previous session's sell-off.

events.title: Continued Consolidation Called For Thai Stock Market
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved lower in five straight sessions, retreating more than 40 points or 2.7 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,580-point plateau and it's expected to spin its wheels again on Wednesday.

events.title: Lower Open Expected For Indonesia Bourse
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in five straight sessions, sinking more than 225 points or 3.4 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,460-point plateau and it's looking at another soft start again on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading modestly lower on Wednesday, extending the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling to near the 63,350 level, with weakness index heavyweights partially offset by gains in automakers and financial stocks.

events.title: Hang Seng May Extend Tuesday's Losses
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market headed south again on Tuesday, one day after ending the five-day losing streak in which it had given up more than 850 points or 3 percent. The Hang Seng Index now sits just shy of the 24,670-point plateau and it may be stuck in neutral again on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Higher
events.description: Australian shares are trading modestly higher on Wednesday, reversing some of the losses in the previous session, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving well above the 8,650 level, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with gains in energy and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in technology stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market Poised To Open Under Pressure
events.description: The China stock market has moved lower in four straight sessions, slumping more than 85 points or 2.3 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,860-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the red again on Wednesday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in four straight sessions, surrendering more than 1,650 points or 3 percent in that span. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 45,500-point plateau and it may continue to sputter on Wednesday.

events.title: Japan Has Y1.105 Trillion Trade Shortfall In August
events.description: Japan posted a merchandise trade deficit of 1.105 trillion yen in August, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.
